item.name: Seed Shop
item.refreshCadence: Main stock every 5 minutes; Daily Deals every 24 hours
item.description: The Seed Shop, also called Sam's Shop, lets players buy the majority of crop seeds available in the game. Seeds here can be purchased with Sheckles, Robux or Trade Token. Seeds can also be gifted with Robux. It runs on a stock system, so not all crop seeds are consistently available at all times. However, there are notable exceptions: Carrot, Strawberry,Blueberry and Tomato seeds always stay in stock. If an item is sold out, like in other stores, the purchase button will be grey and say "NO STOCK." The main stock refreshes every 5 minutes, and the Daily Deals shop refreshes every 24 hours, which lets previously unavailable seeds rotate back into stock. The rarer the seed is, the less likely it will be available in the shop.

item.name: Gear Shop
item.description: The Gear Shop, also called Eloise's Gear Shop, is one of the main shops in the game, where various gear can be bought with sheckles. It is found at one of the sides of the game area, at the opposite side of the Seed Shop and the Sell Stuff stand and is between the Cosmetics Shop and the Pet Eggs Shop. The initial gear stock in the shop is the same throughout all servers, and changes every 5 minutes, bringing in a new set of gear to buy. Watering Can, Trowel, Recall Wrench, Trading Ticket, Favorite Tool and Harvest Tool are guaranteed to be in stock whenever the shop resets.

item.name: Pet Eggs Shop
item.description: The Pet Eggs Shop is one of the main shops in Grow a Garden. It is mainly used to sell pet eggs and help expand pet slots. Raphael used to be the Quest Giver but that role moved to the Pet Eggs Shop after the Pet Update. It is one of the main stands in Grow a Garden. This stand holds the pet eggs. Once every 30 minutes, the egg stock refreshes. The stand has a yellow and white striped spawning over it. It is made out of dark wood. On the top, there is a wood sign that says PET EGGS in yellow text. On the left side, a separate stand lets players refresh the egg stock on demand for Robux. It sits beside the Gear Shop and the Pet Mutations machine.

item.name: Limited Time Shop
item.description: The Cosmetic Shop was added in version 1.07.0. The player can use it to add decorations to spice up the look of their garden. This is considered a late game shop as everything in the shop is very costly. The crafting table moved here in version 1.11.0. Check Cosmetics for a full list of the cosmetics. The Cosmetic Shop is a small tent that is covered like any other with a white and purple striped cloth. Next to it is a brown sign that says, “Crafting Tables”
